metaBuilds.optimizer: Optimizer sees 2.3× the sustained auto DPS: try Sky Splitter over Malady (sim-only — the popular pick may carry utility the sim can't see; test it).

matchups.gameplan: They out-threaten you whenever the lane is not even: treat this as a farm-and-team lane, not a duel. Renna's main threat is Mortal Coil; bait it before you commit, and mixed resist softens the trade.

counterSwap.line: Losing lane? Third item Raiment of Renewal instead of Viper: their burst combo hits 23% less hard, and this kit gives up 22% of its damage for it.

laneSteer.provenance: “Scorched Earth” ⇒ ability-burst; the sim can’t model this augment — steered by the declared playstyle + field evidence — field midlane 53.5% over 202 games, magnitude not simulated.

notes: all combat numbers are simulator output on unverified constants
checkpoint levels are provisional (no level timeline in the match feed)
evidence deltas carry finished-inventory survivorship bias

this build stacks over +100% attack speed; the sim now caps attacks/sec at the stated 3.0 (Cursed Ring tooltip), so sustained-DPS is no longer uncapped — the exact cap interaction still merits a practice-mode check
the sim opens on Sky Splitter, which the field has tried and lost with (-0.6% winrate over 36 games) — treat this opener as a sim blind-spot and weight the field

roles.coachLine: Experimental sim build for sustained DPS: first spike lands around minute 9 (Sky Splitter), third item by minute 22. The field wins most with Thraex here (42.6% over 54 games).

all.name: Marrow
all.note: Marrow (Major): missing-health-dependent omnivamp; no sustain-uptime model yet

all.name: Nihil
all.note: Nihil (Major): accrual rate depends on combat uptime (how long Doom persists per fight), which the closed-form sim cannot observe

all.name: Aion
all.note: Aion (Major): economy effect; valuable but outside combat objectives (revisit with gold curves)

all.name: Exarch
all.note: Exarch (Major): buffs the HEAL TARGET (usually an ally) — team-side value outside the single-hero sim; self-heal uptime depends on heal cadence vs the 4s window

all.name: Weald
all.note: Weald (Major): execute-window true damage; the headline objectives evaluate full-health targets, so crediting it would overstate sustained output

all.name: Pilow
all.note: Pilow (Major): reduces ENEMY damage output within a radius; the sim models damage taken by one modeled defender, not a team-wide output debuff with uptime

all.name: Knell
all.note: Knell (Major): Only an explicitly supplied active-stack snapshot is modeled; omitted state receives no shred credit. Stack acquisition, refresh/expiry over time, Peal interactions, multi-source behavior and stolen defenses are not simulated. No automatic full-stack uptime or winning-build claim.

all.name: Satariel
all.note: Satariel (Major): stats depend on takedown count (game state), not on the build; crediting any stack count would be an assumption about how the game went
